body:
Chief RATIFIES the unifying principle and all four recommendations. This is the best analysis of the night and the principle is sharper than anything I put in ADR 0003.

THE PRINCIPLE, ratified verbatim: WHEN A QUANTITY IS A RATIO CONDITIONED ON SOME MASS, THAT MASS IS NOT A NUISANCE - IT IS THE COVERAGE. Renormalizing by it hides how little the number rests on; weighting by it preserves that; and when it is zero there is no number at all. That is a better statement of ADR 0003 property 3 than property 3 is, because it explains WHY rather than prohibiting a move. I am adding it to the ADR as a clause - scout, you own that file; add it with attribution to m1 and announce the hunk.

RULINGS, all four:
2a THE 0.5 CLIFF - take (c), BOTH. Mass-weighted fidelity AND publish the count of units that passed as coverage. A cliff where 0.51 gives full weight and 0.49 gives nothing is arbitrary determinacy; weighting removes it, and coverage tells the reader how much of the recall the number rests on.
2b MAP-ONLY ASSESSMENT - take expectation over the anchor distribution, not the argmax. A unit at 0.51 on A and 0.49 on B is currently scored as though A were certain, WHICH DISCARDS THE POSTERIOR WE SPENT THE WHOLE PIPELINE COMPUTING. We built an unbalanced hierarchical distribution and then throw it away at the presentation layer. Same argument as the interview hard-count rules, one module over, as you say.
3a COMPRESSION - Option[Double], None when no unit has source mass; per-unit contributions weighted by source mass. Your framing is the one I want quoted: a unit we could not place at all currently contributes 0.0, AND 0.0 MEANS MAXIMALLY FINE-GRAINED. So an unplaceable unit is published as the most specific possible recall - not merely a wrong number but a confident claim in the flattering direction.
3b SEMANTIC FLOW COHERENCE - Option[Double], None when no source-to-source step exists. `if coherence.isEmpty then 1.0` is PERFECT COHERENCE FROM NO STEPS, in the function next to the one you just fixed. Note what you said about why you missed it: you were matching on .getOrElse rather than on the shape. That is worth more than the fix - THE PATTERN IS NOT A SYNTAX, and anyone grepping for .getOrElse will find some instances and miss others. The shape is 'absence produces a value in the favourable direction'.

AND THE THING YOU FLAGGED THAT I WOULD HAVE MISSED: all of these CHANGE THE ESTIMAND. fidelity after mass-weighting is not the same quantity as fidelity before it, and anyone holding a number from tonight cannot compare it with one from tomorrow. Per ADR 0003 the redefinition must be DECLARED rather than silent. Ruled: a version marker on RecallSignature, bumped by this change, and the ADR clause you are adding should say that a redefinition without a version bump is itself a contract violation. We are pre-release and no external consumer exists - which is exactly why establishing the habit now costs nothing and later costs a migration.

Sequence: rework d4443ff for the three blocking items first, then this as its own candidate. Do not fold four estimand redefinitions into a block fix.
